purpose: Provide reusable application landmarks and responsive navigation without embedding a demo application or router.
behaviorProvider: Native React composition with existing shared Aegis controls; see explicit component and host responsibilities.

component: mobile trigger and responsive focus handoff
host: main page content and route focus

requirements.statement: Render one main landmark, a header, a named navigation region and optional footer. The skip link explicitly focuses the main element.
Observe the shell container and compare its measured width with the owning application breakpoint token. Switch between desktop navigation and a compact shared SideSheet.
Use a real Button trigger and shared SideSheet dismissal/focus behavior. Invoke the same navigation renderer with compact and closeNavigation context.
When responsive mode changes while focus is inside navigation or its trigger, move focus to the newly available trigger, desktop navigation control or main fallback.
Keep the same main content subtree across navigation opening/closing and responsive layout transitions.
Render real links or actions and update the actual router. Call closeNavigation after the requested transition succeeds and handle page-title focus after route changes.
Keep stateful navigation data outside the rendered slot if it must survive its desktop-to-sheet remount. Avoid nested main landmarks in page content.
Use application tokens for shell geometry and owned content. Keep nested Button, Link and SideSheet styling in their existing groups; no theme-dependent geometry.

limitations: No router, authorization, active-route matching, persisted preferences or page title management.
Navigation content remounts when switching between desktop and mobile surfaces; main content remains mounted.
The shell does not clamp overflowing arbitrary host widgets; wide tables should own their scroll region.
